test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which regulatory body is the only note issuing authority in India?

options.text: Small Industries Development Bank of India.
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
Securities and Exchange Board of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) **is the** central bank** of India and was established on **April 1, 1935.**
 
• It is responsible for regulating the **monetary policy of India,** managing the country's **foreign exchange reserves**, and **issuing currency notes **and **coins.**
 
• The RBI also acts as a** banker** to the government and other commercial banks in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Small Industries Development Bank of India** (SIDBI) is a financial institution established in **1990.**

 
 
• It was made with the aim of promoting and developing** small-scale industries** in India. 
 
 
 
• **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India** (IRDAI) is a regulatory body that oversees the **insurance sector** in India.
 
 
• It operated under** Ministry of Finance, Government of India.**
 
 
 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India **(SEBI) is a regulatory body that oversees the **securities market **in India. 
 
 
• The chairperson of SEBI is** Madhabi Puri Buch.**
 
• She is SEBI's** first female **chairperson.
